title: Private production-readiness gates and quarterly OKR burn plan
creator: Ethan Nguyen
description: Consolidate and operationalize a quarterly playbook that maps Private/VPC/on-prem feature roadmap items to production-readiness gates and OKR burn signals. Deliver clear gating criteria, telemetry signals, and stakeholder runbooks so regulated customers can be onboarded predictably with measurable risk reduction.
scope: Define minimum production-readiness checklist for Private instances (networking, KMS, upgrade path, RBAC)
Map current quarter initiatives to OKR burn targets and success metrics
Establish gating criteria per tranche with automated telemetry checks
Create runbooks for rollback, upgrade windows, and incident escalation for private deployments
Deliver a one-page customer readiness checklist and internal launch checklist
acceptance_criteria: Checklist authoring reviewed and approved by Security and SRE
Automated telemetry alarms defined in Console and validated in staging
At least three representative customer onboarding dry-runs completed without major blockers
OKR burn metrics instrumented and visible on the Private Dashboard
Release playbook merged into Confluence and linked from rollout pipeline
milestones: 2026-02-05: Draft production-readiness checklist completed by PM and SRE
2026-02-28: Telemetry alarm prototypes shipped to staging
2026-03-10: Dry-run #1 with early access customer (internal fixes identified)
2026-03-25: Finalize runbook and merge playbook to Confluence
2026-04-05: OKR burn metrics validated on dashboard
risks: Undiscovered infra incompatibilities in customer networks leading to longer onboarding time — mitigation: schedule pre-onboard network sweeps and provide diagnostics toolkit
Telemetry gaps between Console and Private control plane — mitigation: include telemetry shim and acceptance test in CI
Upgrade path rollback complexity for air-gapped installs — mitigation: provide documented rollback checklist and test during dry-runs
Cross-team bandwidth constraints during quarter causing delayed approvals — mitigation: pre-schedule review slots and escalate unblockers weekly
